title: A Club On The Edge of Town
description: Brett Chapman returns to Leeds theatre company Slung Low, following his film ‘Standing In The Rain’ (LIFF33). Based in Holbeck Working Men’s Club, possibly the oldest club in the UK, Slung Low responds to the current pandemic by acting on its core values, in support of the community it serves.
directors: like many working-class housing estates across Britain
due to years of poverty driven by government policy. But what is the human story of youth growing up in this environment? City of Children is an observational portrait of these lives
